## Summary

What changed and why. One or two sentences.

## Related issue

Closes #(issue number), if any.

## How to test

Steps a reviewer can follow to verify the change locally.

## Screenshots / recording

For any UI change, please attach a before/after screenshot or a short
screen recording.

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm build` is clean (`tsc -b` passes)
- [ ] `pnpm lint` introduces no new warnings
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and my change respects
      the architecture invariants in [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md)
- [ ] If this is a user-facing change, the release notes draft has been
      updated (RELEASES.md)
